items.title: Peter Vacher interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clearwater Beach, Florida, March 18, 2001
items.q: after this hearing Sidney Bechet on record, I started to think well I must try and do something.

ctx.x: Did you lean towards being a writer even before the music—

I was always good at English, I was always capable when it came to writing, but I hadn’t thought in terms of writing. No, what led me to writing was falling for the music and wanting to play the music. And very early on, about sixteen or seventeen, after this hearing Sidney Bechet on record, I started to think well I must try and do something. And what I remember in particular was “The Glenn Miller Story,” when that came out. My pal and I saw it three times in one week. And I remember to this day walking up,…
So you hadn’t played the trombone before that?
